summary: E2E testing of NeXify AI rebranding site (Next.js + FastAPI + Supabase). All backend APIs and critical frontend flows are working. 6/6 backend pytest cases pass; frontend home, pricing calculator, navigation to all 15 pages (incl. legal), language switcher (Impressum -> Colofon), contact form, and NOVA chat widget with full offer email flow all verified successfully.

issues: FAQ items and article toggles do not expose aria-expanded attribute – minor a11y improvement; items are clickable and function per user report but hard to verify open/close state via automation.

action_items: Optional: add aria-expanded="true|false" to FAQ (faq-item-*) and Wissen article-toggle-* buttons for better a11y and easier testing
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: SYSTEM_PROMPT uses str.replace('{language}', ...) which works but is brittle – consider .format() with escaped braces (currently OK because history is cached per session).

server.py: HISTORY is stored in-process memory (not Redis) – on multi-instance deployment the SSE chat and /api/offers/request will lose context. Fine for single Uvicorn process but should be flagged if scaling.
server.py: send_email uses asyncio.to_thread(resend.Emails.send) – OK; but no retry/backoff on transient Resend failures.
chat-widget.tsx: works well and streams properly. Consider abort controller for in-flight fetch if user closes panel mid-stream.
test_credentials: None required. Test recipient email: support@nexify-automate.com (used for both contact + offer flows).
seed_data_creation: Test rows created in Supabase: nexify_leads (2x TEST_Automation), nexify_chat_sessions (~5), nexify_chat_messages (multiple), nexify_offers (1x TEST_Automation). Safe to leave or delete via `delete from nexify_leads where name like 'TEST_%'` etc.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL is https://rebranding-hub-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_nexify_api.py – run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. LLM (MiMo mimo-v2.5-pro) responses take 10-30s; use generous timeouts. Chat widget auto-opens after 6s only when localStorage['nova-greeted'] is unset. Follow-up worker runs every 15min – ignore in tests.
rca of the issue: N/A – no bugs found during this pass.
